decisive_items: AFB PCR probe of hilar lymph node was positive
Second FESS AFB PCR probe was positive
response.rationale: Positive AFB PCR (twice) strongly indicates tuberculosis, despite negative initial staining. Noncaseating granulomas and mediastinal lymphadenopathy can occur in TB; normal ACE and ANCA argue against sarcoidosis and GPA.

rejected.why: Normal ACE and positive AFB PCR make sarcoidosis less likely; noncaseating granulomas are not specific.
ANCA panel normal and noncaseating granulomas are atypical for GPA; PCR positivity points to infection.
